title: net1 v8: net1 v7's recipe with the chosen 27 heads
description: net1 v8 is our architecture (a distribution per LCF: 64 bins, three members, the log score) with the head set of neto1 v2, trained on net1 v7's data (exp-net1v6-229) with its settings (dropout 0.05, width 512), seeds 0 to 2. The head set was chosen on validation rows from exp-neto1-heads-233 and exp-neto1-composites-236 by a rule fixed beforehand: keep net1's seven LCFs; keep every stored label and composite whose head reaches R^2 0.3 (this drops random_drop_fraction at 0.02 and sending_ratio at 0.25); drop a composite whose formula on its parts' heads scores within 0.02 of its own head, since net2 can compute it (this drops departure_rate_bps, available_capacity_bps, excess_demand_bps, bdp_pkts and cross_arrival_rate_bps). That leaves 27 heads: 21 stored labels and six composites (load_factor, littles_delay_ns, normalized_inflight, normalized_power, fair_share_bps, rtt_ratio), whose formulas score below their heads on estimated parts, most of them because they divide by an estimate. net1 v7 (seven heads, the run in its chosen.txt) is reported on the same rows, so the table shows whether 20 more heads cost the first seven any accuracy or coverage. Settings are net1 v7's and are not searched here. The test rows select nothing.
run: uv run python experiments/net1_train.py "$OUT/net1-v8-s$SEED" --spec experiments/specs/net1v4.json --set dropout=0.05 --set width=512 --set 'lcfs=["queue_delay_mean_ns", "queue_pkts", "capacity_bps", "free_buffer_pkts", "busy_fraction", "one_way_delay_ns", "receive_rate_bps", "queue_delay_ns", "ack_queue_delay_mean_ns", "queue_bytes", "queue_min_pkts", "flow_queue_pkts", "capacity_ahead_bps", "buffer_pkts", "buffer_fill", "base_rtt_ns", "arrival_rate_bps", "flow_arrival_rate_bps", "active_flows", "random_loss_rate", "cross_traffic_share", "load_factor", "littles_delay_ns", "normalized_inflight", "normalized_power", "fair_share_bps", "rtt_ratio"]' --seed $SEED --stride 24 --data "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" "$IN/d60/campaign-train60" "$IN/w/campaign-wide30" "$IN/w/campaign-wide120" --ood competitors="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-competitors" --ood loss="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-loss" --ood rtt="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-rtt" --ood buffer="$IN/ood/campaign-ood-buffer" --ood rtt-wide="$IN/w/campaign-ood-rtt-wide" --ood buffer-wide="$IN/w/campaign-ood-buffer-wide" --compare "$IN/m/$(cat "$IN/m/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"
